source.title: Scales of the Destroyer — WoWDB LIVE item Quick Info

notes: SOURCE-LEVEL FLAG ONLY. WoWDB LIVE Quick Info for exact ID 212032 (mail chest, rare TWW Evoker Destroyer's Scarred Wards set) labels 'Can be refunded' and 'Cannot be disenchanted'; added-in patch 11.0.0 build 54210 refers to item introduction, not when DE eligibility was observed. This does not prove that a nonrefundable or differently bonused Retail instance is ineligible. No observed casts, quantity, result, outcome, skill, specialization, bonus ID, or refund age. Do not set numeric zero, measured probability or guaranteed current-game eligibility. Original item IDs were already in the token-reward evidence; this is new source eligibility metadata, not a new independent numerical cohort.
